system.notes:
The ghost of a dead planet is a figure of blue haze and stars. It vaguely resembles the form of the creatures beholding it – their very thoughts give it shape. It cannot die; it can only change states. In life, it surged with titanic heat and clamor. In death, it is a small thing, reflecting quietly upon that which once was. The ghost of a dead planet walks among us, eternal, waiting for the endless cycle of destruction and rebirth to begin once again.

Movement: NEAR (fly)
system.description:
Attacks: 2 void touch +10 (2d10) and 2 heat death

Legendary

Undead. Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by enhanced, or Triad sources. Triad Powers targeting the ghost are DC 18 to use.

Blink. In place of attacks, teleport up to a FAR distance.

Heat

Death. One living target in NEAR DC 15 CON or 2d6 CON damage (death at 0).

Incorporeal. In place of attacks, become corporeal or incorporeal. Cannot attack while incorporeal.

Rebirth. When brought to 0 HP, the ghost collapses into a point of light that teleports into clear, open space away from any other celestial bodies. In one hour, the light explodes outward, and a new planet is born in that location. Anything in the blast zone is vaporized.
